tokens.name: window-bg
tokens.usage: Window background behind headerbar and status line. GNOME: --window-bg-color. macOS: NSColor.windowBackgroundColor (Day/Dusk); Night: solid fill, no material.

tokens.name: view-bg
tokens.usage: Lists, text fields, tables, data monitor. GNOME: --view-bg-color. macOS: NSColor.controlBackgroundColor / textBackgroundColor.

tokens.name: sidebar-bg
tokens.usage: Left sidebar pages (Navigation, Instruments, Weather, Traffic). GNOME: --sidebar-bg-color. macOS: .sidebar material in Day/Dusk; solid in Night.

tokens.name: headerbar-bg
tokens.usage: Header bar / unified toolbar. GNOME: --headerbar-bg-color. macOS: toolbar (titlebar material) in Day/Dusk; solid in Night.

tokens.name: card-bg
tokens.usage: Cards floating over the chart: router preview, navigating card, weather timeline, map control cluster. Near-opaque on purpose: no blur over the live chart. GNOME: --card-bg-color on .card / .osd override. macOS: solid view with this fill (no NSVisualEffectView over the canvas).

tokens.name: popover-bg
tokens.usage: Popovers and menus: layers, aid info, right-click menu. GNOME: --popover-bg-color. macOS: NSPopover/NSMenu follow appearance; Night overrides the popover's content view fill.

tokens.name: dialog-bg
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs: Get weather, Weather route, Best departure, Preferences. GNOME: --dialog-bg-color. macOS: sheet window background.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal sheets and the narrow-width sidebar overlay. GNOME: AdwDialog/AdwOverlaySplitView dimming. macOS: sheet dimming is system-drawn; use only for the overlay sidebar.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: separators, card outline in Dusk/Night, list dividers. GNOME: --border-color. macOS: NSColor.separatorColor.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning (entry outline, toggle off state, focusable control edge): 3:1 on view-bg in every palette. GNOME: entry/button outline in style.css. macOS: custom stroke on Night only; system controls elsewhere.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface above (window-bg, view-bg, sidebar-bg, card-bg, dialog-bg, popover-bg). GNOME: --window-fg-color / --view-fg-color. macOS: NSColor.labelColor (Day/Dusk); Night: this value.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, units, captions, freshness labels, hints, on the same surfaces as text. GNOME: .dim-label (opacity is not used in Night: set this colour). macOS: secondaryLabelColor (Day/Dusk); Night: this value.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only. Not for information.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Accent as text or icon on surfaces: links, selected sidebar item glyph, active toggle glyph. Not used on the chart. GNOME: --accent-color. macOS: .tint / controlAccentColor overridden by the app.

tokens.name: accent-bg
tokens.usage: Filled accent: suggested-action button, selected switch, selected row. GNOME: --accent-bg-color (+ .suggested-action). macOS: .tint for borderedProminent buttons.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-bg. GNOME: --accent-fg-color. macOS: white label on prominent buttons; Night: this value.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid, 2px offset: at least 3:1 on every surface. GNOME: outline in style.css. macOS: keyboardFocusIndicatorColor overridden via tint in Night.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected object on the chart (route, waypoint, AIS target): 3px outer halo ring. Also list selection. Never used for a chart object's own colour.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover and press highlight on clickable chart overlays and rows.

tokens.name: alarm-bg
tokens.usage: ALARM level fill (collision, anchor drag, shallow water, lost fix while navigating). Full-width banner + chart edge frame. The ONLY saturated red in Night chrome, and the only element allowed above the Night brightness ceiling. GNOME: AdwBanner.alarm, --error-bg-color. macOS: custom banner view.

tokens.name: on-alarm
tokens.usage: Text and icons on alarm-bg.

tokens.name: alarm
tokens.usage: Alarm red as text, icon or chart mark on ordinary surfaces (e.g. dangerous AIS target, depth readout in alarm). GNOME: --error-color. macOS: systemRed replaced by this value.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: WARNING level fill (stale forecast, off course, wind over limit, data source lost). Banner, no pulse. GNOME: AdwBanner.warning, --warning-bg-color. macOS: custom banner view.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons on warning-bg.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning amber as text or icon on ordinary surfaces (stale badge, readout over limit). GNOME: --warning-color. macOS: systemOrange replaced by this value.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: INFO level fill: toasts / HUD messages (route completed, forecast downloaded, arrived at waypoint). GNOME: AdwToast (style.css override). macOS: in-window HUD.

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Text and icons on info-bg.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Connected / fresh / within limits: connection dot, anchor watch armed, fresh data badge. GNOME: --success-color. macOS: systemGreen replaced by this value. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: stale
tokens.usage: Stale or unknown data: forecast past its run, position fix older than 30 s, tiles past age. Shown with a hatched badge and the age in words, never colour alone.

tokens.name: overlay-halo
tokens.usage: 1.5px halo under every overlay stroke and label. Lines with a halo are ours; S-52/INT 1 chart lines never have one. This is the main rule that keeps overlays from reading as chart objects.

tokens.name: own-ship
tokens.usage: Own ship hull, heading line, COG/SOG vector, anchor symbol, measure line. Black in Day for sun glare; light in Dusk/Night over the dark chart.

tokens.name: own-ship-trail
tokens.usage: Track trail behind own ship (dotted) and recorded tracks.

tokens.name: route
tokens.usage: Routes and their waypoints. Signal orange: clear of S-52/INT 1 magenta (hue ~300°), of red/green light flares and of alarm red. Night: dim amber, no red.

tokens.name: route-inactive
tokens.usage: Inactive routes (dashed 6/4).

tokens.name: route-corridor
tokens.usage: XTE corridor fill of the active leg.

tokens.name: on-route
tokens.usage: Waypoint numbers and leg labels set on a route-coloured chip.

tokens.name: ais
tokens.usage: AIS targets in normal state (outline triangle, COG vector, label).

tokens.name: ais-danger
tokens.usage: Dangerous AIS target: filled triangle, CPA line and CPA point, label in bold. Pairs with the alarm banner.

tokens.name: ais-lost
tokens.usage: Lost AIS target (no report for 6 min Class A / 3 min Class B): dashed outline with a cross.

tokens.name: anchor-circle
tokens.usage: Anchor watch swing circle (dashed) when armed and holding. Switches to alarm when dragging.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Measure tool line and tick marks; readout chip uses card-bg.

tokens.name: isobar
tokens.usage: Isobars and their pressure labels; H / L centres in bold.

tokens.name: wind-barb
tokens.usage: Wind barbs and arrows over the wind field.

tokens.name: isochrone
tokens.usage: Past isochrone fronts (thin).

tokens.name: isochrone-now
tokens.usage: The isochrone front at the clock (heavy, with halo). Clickable to create an alternative.

tokens.name: router-boat
tokens.usage: Boat marker on each alternative at the clock time.

tokens.name: router-motor
tokens.usage: The stretches of an alternative sailed under engine, in place of its own colour.

tokens.name: alt-1
tokens.usage: Router alternative 1 (the computed route; becomes the route on Use): solid line.

tokens.name: alt-2
tokens.usage: Router alternative 2: long dash 10/4.

tokens.name: alt-3
tokens.usage: Router alternative 3: dash-dot 8/3/2/3.

tokens.name: alt-4
tokens.usage: Router alternative 4: short dash 4/3.

tokens.name: alt-5
tokens.usage: Router alternative 5: dotted 1.5/3 (round caps).

tokens.name: alt-6
tokens.usage: Router alternative 6: dash-dot-dot 8/3/2/3/2/3.

tokens.name: wind-00
tokens.usage: Wind field 0–6 kn (calm). Field is drawn at 55% opacity under barbs; ramp also printed in the legend with numbers.

tokens.name: wind-06
tokens.usage: Wind 6–12 kn.

tokens.name: wind-12
tokens.usage: Wind 12–17 kn (F4).

tokens.name: wind-17
tokens.usage: Wind 17–22 kn (F5).

tokens.name: wind-22
tokens.usage: Wind 22–28 kn (F6).

tokens.name: wind-28
tokens.usage: Wind 28–34 kn (F7). Brick, darker than alarm red and never a stroke.

tokens.name: wind-34
tokens.usage: Wind 34–41 kn (F8). Deep crimson-maroon instead of magenta, so the field cannot read as S-52 magenta.

tokens.name: wind-41
tokens.usage: Wind 41–48 kn (F9). Dark aubergine: luminance keeps falling, so CVD readers still see order.

tokens.name: wind-48
tokens.usage: Wind 48+ kn (F10+). Near-black.

tokens.name: wave-0
tokens.usage: Significant wave height 0–0.5 m.

tokens.name: wave-05
tokens.usage: Waves 0.5–1 m.

tokens.name: wave-1
tokens.usage: Waves 1–2 m.

tokens.name: wave-2
tokens.usage: Waves 2–3 m.

tokens.name: wave-3
tokens.usage: Waves 3–5 m.

tokens.name: wave-5
tokens.usage: Waves 5–8 m.

tokens.name: wave-8
tokens.usage: Waves 8 m and more. Dusk/Night invert lightness so big seas stand out on the dark chart.

tokens.name: current-arrow
tokens.usage: Current arrows over the chart and the current field: one weight per speed band, each with the halo, the speed in caption at the tail from zoom 12.

tokens.name: current-0
tokens.usage: Current field 0–0.5 kn (slack). Drawn at 55% opacity like the wind field, and only instead of it.

tokens.name: current-05
tokens.usage: Current 0.5–1 kn.

tokens.name: current-1
tokens.usage: Current 1–2 kn.

tokens.name: current-2
tokens.usage: Current 2–3 kn.

tokens.name: current-3
tokens.usage: Current 3–4 kn: a race.

tokens.name: current-4
tokens.usage: Current 4 kn and more. Dusk/Night invert lightness, as the wave ramp does.

tokens.name: cost-best
tokens.usage: Best departure timeline: lowest cost (best) departure bars.

tokens.name: cost-mid
tokens.usage: Middle cost.

tokens.name: cost-worst
tokens.usage: Highest cost (worst) — pale so the eye goes to the good ones.

tokens.name: cost-night-band
tokens.usage: Darkness bands behind the departure timeline and in route statistics.

tokens.name: chart-land
tokens.usage: Land (buff), INT 1 paper style.

tokens.name: chart-land-built
tokens.usage: Built-up areas on land.

tokens.name: chart-coast
tokens.usage: Coastline and land outlines.

tokens.name: chart-drying
tokens.usage: Intertidal / drying areas (green).

tokens.name: chart-shallow
tokens.usage: Depth band 0 m to 5 m (deep blue tint).

tokens.name: chart-medium
tokens.usage: Depth band 5 m to the safety contour (light blue tint).

tokens.name: chart-deep
tokens.usage: Deep water beyond the safety contour (white).

tokens.name: chart-contour
tokens.usage: Depth contours (hairline).

tokens.name: chart-land-contour
tokens.usage: Land contours (hairline), brown as on a paper chart.

tokens.name: chart-land-contour-index
tokens.usage: Every fifth land contour, heavier.

tokens.name: chart-relief-shadow
tokens.usage: Hillshade: the shaded side of a slope, painted with partial opacity over the land.

tokens.name: chart-relief-light
tokens.usage: Hillshade: the lit side of a slope, painted with partial opacity over the land.

tokens.name: chart-safety-contour
tokens.usage: Safety contour (bold).

tokens.name: chart-sounding
tokens.usage: Soundings (italic) and drying heights (underlined).

tokens.name: chart-ink
tokens.usage: Chart text, beacons, black buoy bands and topmarks, rocks and wrecks.

tokens.name: chart-magenta
tokens.usage: INT 1 magenta: restricted areas, cables, 'other colour' light flares, radio. Reserved for the chart. Nothing Isomar draws over the chart may use a hue between 280° and 340°.

tokens.name: light-white
tokens.usage: Light flare / sector for white and yellow lights (yellow tear, thin ink outline).

tokens.name: light-red
tokens.usage: Light flare / sector for red lights.

tokens.name: light-green
tokens.usage: Light flare / sector for green lights.

tokens.name: light-other
tokens.usage: Light flare for other colours (blue, violet, orange) and lights of unknown colour: INT 1 magenta.

tokens.name: mark-red
tokens.usage: IALA red (port lateral, safe water stripes, isolated danger band).

tokens.name: mark-green
tokens.usage: IALA green (starboard lateral).

tokens.name: mark-yellow
tokens.usage: IALA yellow (cardinals, special marks).

tokens.name: mark-black
tokens.usage: IALA black (cardinals, isolated danger, topmarks). Outlined with chart-ink in Dusk/Night.

tokens.name: mark-white
tokens.usage: IALA white (safe water stripes).

tokens.name: chart-void
tokens.usage: The void beyond the world's edge and the poles. Added by Isomar; not in the handoff's token set.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Latitude/longitude grid lines and their labels. Added by Isomar; not in the handoff's token set.

tokens.name: chart-label
tokens.usage: Upright chart labels (place names, grid labels, scale bar text). Added by Isomar; not in the handoff's token set.

tokens.name: chart-name-water
tokens.usage: Names of seas, bays, straits and channels, sloping, as on a paper chart. Added by Isomar; not in the handoff's token set.

tokens.name: chart-town-edge
tokens.usage: Outline of built-up areas. Added by Isomar; not in the handoff's token set.

tokens.name: chart-building
tokens.usage: Building footprints. Added by Isomar; not in the handoff's token set.

tokens.name: chart-building-edge
tokens.usage: Building outlines. Added by Isomar; not in the handoff's token set.

tokens.name: chart-sea
tokens.usage: Sea where no depth data is shown. Added by Isomar; not in the handoff's token set.

tokens.name: mark-blue
tokens.usage: Blue in an S-57 colour list (emergency wreck marking). Added by Isomar; not in the handoff's token set.

styles.name: readout-xl
styles.usage: Under-way hero readouts (depth, SOG) readable at 2 m. Tabular figures always (font-feature-settings 'tnum'). GNOME: .readout-xl + .numeric. macOS: .system(size: 56, weight: .semibold).monospacedDigit().

styles.name: readout-l
styles.usage: Under-way secondary readouts (COG, wind) and planning hero tiles. GNOME: .readout-l + .numeric. macOS: .system(size: 40, weight: .semibold).monospacedDigit().

styles.name: readout-m
styles.usage: Planning-mode instrument tiles, navigating card (DTW, TTG). GNOME: .readout-m + .numeric. macOS: .system(size: 28, weight: .semibold).monospacedDigit().

styles.name: readout-unit
styles.usage: Unit suffix and label beside a readout, in text-muted. Never inside the number's string so units can switch. GNOME: .caption-heading scaled. macOS: .subheadline.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Dialog titles, sidebar page titles. GNOME: .title-2. macOS: .title (22pt) / .title2.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles over the chart. GNOME: .title-3. macOS: .title3 (15pt) bold.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Group headings, list section titles, banner title. GNOME: .heading. macOS: .headline (13pt).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, row titles, form labels. GNOME: default (11pt ≈ 14.67px). macOS: .body (13pt). Map by role, not by size.

styles.name: body-numeric
styles.usage: Positions, times, distances in lists and tables: tabular figures. GNOME: .numeric. macOS: .body.monospacedDigit().

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Freshness ('Forecast run 06 UTC, 5 h old'), credits, status line. GNOME: .caption. macOS: .caption (10pt) / .footnote.

styles.name: caption-heading
styles.usage: Tile labels above readouts (SOG, DEPTH). Sentence case in source strings; uppercase via the style only, so translations survive. GNOME: .caption-heading. macOS: .caption.weight(.semibold).

styles.name: monospace
styles.usage: Data monitor (raw NMEA). GNOME: .monospace. macOS: .system(.body, design: .monospaced).

styles.name: chart-label
styles.usage: Overlay labels (waypoint names, AIS names, leg labels) with a 2px overlay-halo. Scales with the chart text size preference. Shared renderer embeds Adwaita Sans on both platforms.

styles.name: chart-label-strong
styles.usage: Active waypoint, dangerous AIS, alarm labels.

styles.name: chart-name
styles.usage: Chart names of marks, rocks and sea areas (INT 1 sloping style).

styles.name: chart-light
styles.usage: Light characteristics beside major lights (only when the light is selected or at large scale; otherwise in the aid popover).

styles.name: sounding
styles.usage: Soundings, italic, decimetres as a subscript. Drying heights underlined.

styles.name: chart-grid
styles.usage: Lat/lon grid labels: whole minutes unless zoomed in (never 003°30.000'W). Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Gap between a readout and its unit; icon to badge.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges; between stacked map controls in a cluster.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Inside compact rows; gap between buttons. GNOME: matches 6px HIG spacing rounded to the 4 grid only where the platform has no own metric.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Card padding over the chart; list row padding. GNOME: AdwActionRow paddings are kept native.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Margin between floating cards and the chart edge (regular).

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Dialog content margins; margin to chart edge under way.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Section separation in dialogs and status pages.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Status page / empty state vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Buttons, entries, chips. GNOME: native 6px. macOS: native control radius (5–6pt) — do not override.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Cards over the chart, popovers, boxed lists. GNOME: .card 12px. macOS: 10pt.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Map control cluster, alarm banner corners when floating, readout dashboard tiles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Round map buttons, status pills (Not for navigation, freshness).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and map controls over the chart. Night uses a border instead (no glow, no lightening).

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, sheets.

tokens.name: control-regular
tokens.usage: Planning-mode buttons and rows. GNOME: 34px button height (native). macOS: .controlSize(.regular) 22pt in dialogs and sidebar; 28pt (.large) in the toolbar.

tokens.name: control-underway
tokens.usage: Under-way layout (auto when a route starts): every action button. GNOME: .underway class sets min-height 48px. macOS: custom 44pt buttons (.controlSize(.large) is not enough).

tokens.name: map-control
tokens.usage: Round map controls (zoom, follow, course-up, layers, measure), regular. GNOME: .osd circular button 40px. macOS: 32pt glyph button in a 40pt cluster cell.

tokens.name: map-control-underway
tokens.usage: Map controls under way (cold or wet hands).

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target for any chart object (waypoint, AIS, aid). Picked on a 24px radius around the cursor even when the symbol is smaller.

tokens.name: hit-min-underway
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target for chart objects under way.

tokens.name: readout-tile
tokens.usage: Minimum width of an instrument tile; dashboard reflows by this width.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Left sidebar width (GNOME: AdwOverlaySplitView min-sidebar-width 300, max 360; macOS: NavigationSplitView column 300–360pt).

tokens.name: hit-min-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for every control and chart object on iPhone, iPhone Duo and iPad (44 pt, Apple HIG). Planning and under way alike.

tokens.name: hit-min-android
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for every control and chart object on Android phones and tablets (48 dp, Material).

tokens.name: map-control-touch
tokens.usage: Round map controls on phones and tablets in planning mode. Under way they grow to map-control-underway (56).

tokens.name: sheet-peek
tokens.usage: Collapsed height of the phone bottom sheet above the home indicator: grabber, page switcher and one status line. Medium detent is half the screen, large leaves the top inset clear.

tokens.name: nav-rail-width
tokens.usage: Android tablet navigation rail holding the five page icons; the page panel (sidebar-width) sits beside it.

tokens.name: floating-bar-height
tokens.usage: Height of the status pill and action capsule floating at the top of the chart on phones and tablets.

tokens.name: stroke-halo
tokens.usage: Halo on each side of every overlay stroke (overlay-halo).

tokens.name: stroke-route
tokens.usage: Inactive route line.

tokens.name: stroke-route-active
tokens.usage: Active route line; selected route gets a selection ring on top.

tokens.name: stroke-vector
tokens.usage: COG/SOG vector, heading line (1.5px), AIS vectors.

tokens.name: stroke-front
tokens.usage: Past isochrone fronts.

tokens.name: stroke-front-now
tokens.usage: Isochrone front at the clock.

tokens.name: stroke-alarm-frame
tokens.usage: Alarm frame around the chart viewport (pulses 4→8px at 1 Hz; static 8px with reduced motion).

tokens.name: stroke-sector-arc
tokens.usage: Light sector arc band (INT 1 'big arc'), drawn at sector-radius.

tokens.name: sector-radius
tokens.usage: Radius of light sector arcs on screen (S-52 uses 25 mm for major lights), for a 10 nm light; other ranges scale from it within 0.4 to 1.5 times. Option: arcs at full nominal range ('Full-length light sectors').

tokens.name: flare-length
tokens.usage: Light flare (tear) length for a light of up to 5 nm (or unknown range), growing to 1.5 times at 25 nm; drawn 135° from north from the light's position (rotated away from other flares when lights share a position).

tokens.name: buoy-height
tokens.usage: Buoy symbol height; topmarks add 2.5 mm. Buoys lean 15° (INT 1 style); beacons stand upright.

tokens.name: ownship-length
tokens.usage: Own ship symbol length at small scale; switches to true-scale hull outline when the hull is longer on screen.

tokens.name: alarm-pulse
tokens.usage: Alarm frame and banner pulse period. Reduce motion: no pulse, static thick frame; sound unchanged.

tokens.name: alarm-repeat
tokens.usage: Alarm sound repeats every 4 s until acknowledged; snooze 2 min (collision) / 5 min (anchor).

tokens.name: panel-slide
tokens.usage: Sidebar and card slide. Reduce motion: crossfade 100 ms.

tokens.name: danger-blink
tokens.usage: Dangerous AIS target blink (on 500 / off 500) until acknowledged. Reduce motion: steady fill + ring.

tokens.name: toast-duration
tokens.usage: Info toast / HUD lifetime.
